# Grounded Land Services

> Grounded Land Services is a land clearing and site development company based in Bertram, Texas, serving the Austin Metro, Texas Hill Country, Central Texas, and San Antonio area. Services include traditional land clearing, forestry mulching, rock removal, cedar tree removal, rock and cactus removal, rock crushing, demolition, and site preparation. Doing land clearing work since 2020; 100+ projects completed. Licensed and insured. Free on-site estimates.

Phone (call or text): (512) 571-6700 · Email: Logan@groundedlandservices.com
Hours: Mon–Fri 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Sat–Sun 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Not served: Houston, Dallas, Fort Worth, Katy.

## Pricing
- Land clearing: $2,000 – $4,000 per acre
- Forestry mulching: $2,500 – $3,000 per day
- Rock removal: $2,000 – $4,000 per acre
- Rock crushing: $3,000 – $4,000+ per day
- Demolition: $1,500 – $10,000+ per job
- Minimum job: $1,000

## How long jobs take
- Land clearing (excavator): 6–7 acres/day in light brush, 5–6 acres/day in medium brush, 4–5 acres/day in thick cedar.
- Forestry mulching (CAT 275 XE + Prinoth M450s mulching head): about 2–3 acres/day in light brush, about 1.5 acres/day in medium brush, about 1 acre/day in thick cedar.
- Acres per day depend on ground conditions and terrain.

## Services
- [Traditional Land Clearing](https://www.groundedlandservices.com/services/land-clearing): Removes trees, stumps, brush, and debris to create a construction-ready site.
- [Forestry Mulching](https://www.groundedlandservices.com/services/forestry-mulching): Grinds cedar, brush, and small trees into mulch in place, leaving root systems intact.
- [Rock Removal](https://www.groundedlandservices.com/services/rock-removal): Excavates surface rock, boulders, and embedded limestone so land is usable and build-ready.
- [Cedar Tree Removal](https://www.groundedlandservices.com/services/cedar-tree-removal): Removes invasive Ashe juniper (cedar) to reclaim pasture, improve access, and reduce wildfire fuel.
- [Rock & Cactus Removal](https://www.groundedlandservices.com/services/rock-cactus-removal): Removes embedded rock, boulders, and prickly pear cactus interfering with property use.
- [Rock Crushing](https://www.groundedlandservices.com/services/rock-crushing): Processes on-site stone into reusable aggregate for driveways and building pads.
- [Demolition](https://www.groundedlandservices.com/services/demolition): Removes unwanted structures and prepares sites for redevelopment.
- [All Services](https://www.groundedlandservices.com/services): Full list of land clearing and site development services.
